artificial_source.construction: two identical zero BF16 token vectors at every state; zero synthetic IDs; full attention/source/query masks; head first, tail second

metrics.brier_convention: sum_k (softmax(logit)_k - one_hot(target)_k)^2; no division by candidate count
metrics.dev_use: already observed exploratory evidence; no new acceptance threshold
metrics.margin: target logit minus maximum other-candidate logit
metrics.rank: one plus number of strictly higher candidate logits; argmax first-index ties reported

sampler_proof.post_midpoint_continuation: deterministic replay under exact original Torch runtime; no original final RNG artifact
